summary: Rockstar Vancouver's schoolyard action-adventure, expanded through Scholarship Edition and Anniversary Edition.

entries.title: Bully
entries.definitive_edition: Windows Scholarship Edition for main play; Anniversary/Wii/Xbox 360 for multiplayer content

emulation.emulator: Native Windows; Android/iOS or Dolphin/Xenia for multiplayer modes where legal
emulation.notes: Use Windows for the main run; use mobile/Wii/Xbox routes only for multiplayer preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows Scholarship Edition, with mobile/Wii/Xbox multiplayer as secondary

primary.why: Bully released on PlayStation 2, then expanded as Scholarship Edition for Wii, Xbox 360, and Windows, with Anniversary Edition later on Android and iOS. Windows Scholarship Edition is the highest-fidelity route for the expanded single-player game, while Wii/Xbox 360/mobile versions preserve multiplayer modes absent from Windows.
primary.how_to_play: Play Scholarship Edition on Windows for the main run; sample Android/iOS Anniversary Edition or the Wii/Xbox 360 Scholarship Edition only for the multiplayer/Friend Challenge content.

secondary.exclusive_content: Anniversary Edition Friend Challenges / multiplayer content
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the mobile Anniversary Edition multiplayer/Friend Challenges after the Windows main run if preserving every mode matters.
secondary.why: Multiplayer is available only on Wii, Xbox 360, and Anniversary Edition, not Windows.

entries.remaster_caveats: Anniversary Edition is useful for multiplayer/Friend Challenges but is a mobile route. The fan-made Bully Online mod launched in 2025 and shut down in January 2026, so it is not treated as official archive content.
